fieldValues.title: Issue templates in each governed repo carry the flow shape
fieldValues.move: Each governed repo has an issue template for a work item (Answers, Part of, Remedy, Ruling, Problem, Technical plan, Acceptance) and one for a bug (found while, version, steps, expected, actual, severity, done when), so GitHub shows the shape at the moment of filing.
fieldValues.does_not_fix: Whether the problem named in Answers exists (clerk place) and whether the epic is ranked; the templates only show the shape.
fieldValues.falsifier: After the templates exist, issues are still filed without the sections the flow check asks for.

createdBy.name: Claude Code (deriving from the owner vignettes, 2026-10-25)
